annotations.title: Show something on the call page

description: Put a card on the person's call page (never spoken): text, code, a link or an image. kind: text (default), code (monospace with copy button), link (exactly one http(s) URL, shown as a tappable link), image (`image` = SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP, line breaks, a data:image/...;base64, prefix and missing padding are accepted; or `file_id` of an image uploaded with the REST endpoint POST /api/bridge/upload, which keeps large base64 out of the tool call). A new card appears as a small preview top left; panel cards opens the cards view, board, log or decisions open those panels, none closes them. large: true opens the cards view big in the middle with this card at full size (diagrams, swimlanes; implies panel cards). SVG may draw anything (no scripts, no foreignObject, no external references). Limits: text 4000 chars, title 80, SVG 300 KB, raster 1024 KB.

file_id.description: kind image: id from POST /api/bridge/upload (same call, same limits and checks as image); instead of image.
file_id.title: File Id

image.description: kind image: SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP (SVG max 300 KB, raster max 1 MB).
image.title: Image

large.description: Open the cards view big in the middle with this card at full size.
large.title: Large

text.description: Card text, max 4000 chars (code: the code; link: the URL).
text.title: Text
